observation: Storage tray, coherent. Iso: a flat rectangular slab with eight shallow circular sockets in a regular 4 by 2 grid, evenly spaced and all the same size, none breaking the slab edge. Front view: one plain slab of constant thickness. The top view carries no information here -- this renderer is flat-shaded, so a socket floor parallel to the top face takes the same tone as the face -- and the iso resolves it. Nothing missing, nothing extra, no floating geometry.
